body:
The gateway forwarded string and enum variables to source schemas through UTF-16 strings: variable coercion called `JsonElement.GetString()` for every value, and `FetchResultStore` transcoded those strings back to UTF-8 when writing the source schema request.

This PR keeps forwarded variables in UTF-8. `JsonVariableCoercion` copies the raw UTF-8 bytes of string and enum values into the request's `Utf8MemoryBuilder` (unescaping them when the JSON string contains escape sequences) and creates segment-backed `StringValueNode` and `EnumValueNode` literals. `FetchResultStore` writes string, enum, int and float literals from their UTF-8 spans, so no strings are created for forwarded variables.

## Benchmarks

### Enums (21 enum values)

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Gateway request | `main` | 20.04 μs | 1.00 | 31.55 KB | 1.00 |
| Gateway request | PR | 19.47 μs | 0.97 | 31.03 KB | 0.98 |
| Variable coercion | `main` | 1.310 μs | 1.00 | 2.59 KB | 1.00 |
| Variable coercion | PR | 1.215 μs | 0.93 | 2.04 KB | 0.79 |

### 256 character strings (21 values)

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Gateway request | `main` | 21.84 μs | 1.00 | 41.91 KB | 1.00 |
| Gateway request | PR | 21.70 μs | 0.99 | 36.25 KB | 0.86 |
| Variable coercion | `main` | 2.279 μs | 1.00 | 13.03 KB | 1.00 |
| Variable coercion | PR | 2.308 μs | 1.01 | 7.34 KB | 0.56 |

### 16 KB lorem ipsum string (1 value)

| Method | Version | Mean | Ratio | Allocated | Alloc Ratio |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Gateway request | `main` | 23.82 μs | 1.00 | 61.35 KB | 1.00 |
| Gateway request | PR | 22.33 μs | 0.94 | 45.38 KB | 0.74 |
| Variable coercion | `main` | 2.294 μs | 1.00 | 32.48 KB | 1.00 |
| Variable coercion | PR | 2.165 μs | 0.94 | 16.51 KB | 0.51 |

Gateway requests allocate 2% less with enum variables, 14% less with 256 character strings and 26% less with a 16 KB string, because each forwarded string value is no longer held as a UTF-16 string. With the 16 KB string, the gateway request is also 6% faster. The other time differences are within the measurement error (about ±0.2 to ±0.5 μs for gateway requests).
